results.title: The Cops
results.overview: 90s, in the middle of the night, while a narcissistic policeman and his clumsy intern stand guard on a street, a thief comes to completely disrupt their evening…

results.title: Room 7
results.overview: A rural hotel, run by two mysterious brothers. An unfortunate guest is forced to stay there.

results.title: Malpraxis
results.overview: Virgil, a quiet and somber man, rents an apartment overlooking a woman’s home. He watches her obsessively, waiting for the lover who will lead him to his ultimate revenge.

results.title: The Golden Rule
results.overview: Steingerður has worked in the town office for years. Her new young boss wants to push past the rules and approve a building permit on land that has a known elf rock on it. Steingerður denies the application but comes to find out it might already be too late to save the rock.

results.title: MY KIND OF PEOPLE
results.overview: After a DNA test uncovers his father's adoption, a proud paesano from Providence, Rhode Island grapples with the revelation that he's not actually Italian American, and never has been. With the foundation of his identity destroyed, and his familial bonds broken, he begins to spiral.

results.title: Ruel - Live at Red Bull Symphonic Orchestra Show
results.original_title: Ruel - Live at Red Bull Symphonic Orchestra Show
results.overview: Experience Ruel’s biggest hits like never before, reimagined with Ensemble Apex, a collective of Australia’s most prestigious players, known for redefining the orchestral experience for a new generation.

results.title: Bloodfire
results.overview: An allegory of resistance and liberation woven from Oceania’s past, present and future. A visual companion to the EP of the same name by the Pasifika-First Nations musical collective FAMILI.

results.title: Self-Help
results.overview: A young woman infiltrates a dangerous self-actualization community after her mother becomes entangled with its enigmatic leader.

results.title: Keyhole Conversation
results.overview: Peter Larsson’s Keyhole Conversation draws the eye down to the small gate of the camera. From there, through quivering and percussive forms of direct and stop-motion animation, the eye begins to experience the scale of an image anew. At times segueing into a flicker, but maintaining a charmed form of attention to the marks of pencils and the channels dredged in emulsion by a paintbrush, all to a curious soundtrack of pulses and bleeps.

results.title: Over Easy
results.overview: After getting badly sunburned, a young woman’s misfortune leads her on a strange and unexpected journey through Palm Springs.

results.title: Sharks in Prague
results.overview: Genetically modified bull sharks attack Prague's waterways. Detective Kowalski, Dr. Novak, and Dr. Cerny uncover that Dr. Reef is responsible, seeking to weaponize marine life. They work together to infiltrate his lab, outsmart his defenses, and confront the threat.

results.title: M.R.I. (or, Michael Returns Indefinitely)
results.overview: When Michael’s frustrations with the healthcare industry cause him to openly question his doctor’s motives, he awakens shadowy forces that threaten to fight back.

results.title: The Second Diary of Paulina P.
results.overview: Paulina P. is back, once again facing the challenges of growing up, such as overly strict adults and middle school bullies. However, something even worse will enter her life after she learns about her grandmother's fatal condition.

results.title: How To Get Away From My Toxic Family
results.original_title: How To Get Away From My Toxic Family
results.overview: A hardworking and loyal OFW, a chef from Dubai, returns home hoping to pursue his dream of owning his restaurant and starting his own life. However, he finds himself at odds with his family and their toxic tendencies, making him question “Where does sacrifice end and selfishness begin?"

results.title: Blazing Fists
results.original_title: BLUE FIGHT 蒼き若者たちのブレイキングダウン
results.overview: Ikuto and Ryoma grow close after meeting in juvenile detention. Motivated by Mikuru Asakura's words, they set their sights on the martial arts event Breaking Down, but looming rivalries threaten to derail their dream.

results.title: Truckload
results.overview: Following a near-fatal traffic accident, Lizzie's moving out of her mum's care and back to London (or as Mum calls it, the city of death). But Lizzie's going to live.
